notes: 0.3.39：本机路径这一区只把两类情况当告警——仓库里的「根外绝对路径」和「被覆盖的配置」。以前「待确认路径」也算一项、也会点亮标题行按钮，可它不是告警：它只是"上次拉取时有配置没写进去，得把目录填一次"，属于配置动作，放在告警里会让人以为出了错。现在 status 的 localPaths 多给一个 alert（= 根外 + 被覆盖），按钮只在这个 alert 上变橙、显示「本机路径 · N 项告警」；待确认路径退成卡内的中性提示，明细列表照旧保留。
notesEn: 0.3.39: the Local paths section treats exactly two situations as warnings - absolute paths in the repo outside every root, and configs the last pull overwrote. Paths still to confirm used to count as a third warning and lit up the title-row button, but they are not a warning: they just mean "the last pull skipped some configs, fill the folder in once", which is a configuration step and reads like an error when shown as a warning. status.localPaths now also reports alert (= outside-root + overwritten); the button turns amber and reads "Local paths - N alert(s)" only on that, while paths to confirm drop back to a neutral notice inside the card (the itemised list stays).
